title: AgentsCoMerge: Large Language Model Empowered Collaborative Decision Making for Ramp Merging

live_model.evidence: Table 2 (closed-loop, LimSim++): "GPT-4 Turbo 0.797 0.424 0.907 71.697" (Comfort/Efficiency/Safety/Driving Score) vs. the authors' AgentsCoMerge and other baselines

prompt.note: A prompt example is visualized in a figure; the reflection/fine-tuning prompts described in Sec. 4.5 are for the authors' own trained agent, not clearly the exact baseline prompt given to GPT-4 Turbo.

claim.location: Table 2, row GPT-4 Turbo, DS column (CS 0.797, ES 0.424, SS 0.907)

data.source: LimSim++ / SUMO multi-lane merging simulator; nuScenes and HighD datasets for the open-loop tables

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is one of several closed- and open-source LLM baselines compared against the authors' proposed multi-agent method in a driving simulator. Soft gaps: the exact prompt given to the GPT-4-Turbo baseline isn't clearly separated from the authors' own agent's prompts, and the number of closed-loop episodes underlying Table 2 is not stated.
